name: split
title: Split
description: Two-pane layout with a keyboard and pointer resizable separator.

api.description: Two-pane layout with a keyboard and pointer resizable separator. Pass exactly two children as primary and secondary panes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal splits left and right. vertical splits top and bottom.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Controlled primary pane share as a unit ratio (0 to 1) or a percentage greater than 1.

props.name: defaultRatio
props.description: Uncontrolled initial ratio. Double-clicking the divider restores this value.

props.name: onRatioChange
props.description: Called with the clamped unit ratio after each change.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum primary pane size as a unit ratio, percent string, or pixel object.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum primary pane size as a unit ratio, percent string, or pixel object.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow-key step as a unit ratio.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the divider and removes it from the tab order.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary pane first, secondary pane second.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Separator (role="separator"): The divider exposes aria-orientation and aria-valuenow, min, and max as percentages. Arrow keys step the ratio; Home and End jump to the bounds. There is no name prop on the separator; it may lack a spoken label until the kit adds one.
